 Follow Collin Gosselin Fires Back at Sister Hannah’s ‘Pre-Damage Control’ Move: ‘Caught in the Middle’
 Vanessa Bermudez Fri, October 23, 2026 at 3:00 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. YouTube/ABC News; Hannah Gosselin/Instagram Collin Gosselin is speaking out after his sister, Hannah Gosselin , made a statement that appears to distance herself from his allegations against their mother, Kate Gosselin. 
 During the Thursday, October 22, episode of The View, Collin, 22, reacted to comments his sextuplet sister, Hannah, recently made following the release of his memoir and the news that she, Collin and dad Jon Gosselin are participating in a Netflix documentary about Jon & Kate Plus 8 . 
 On Wednesday, October 21, Hannah wrote on Instagram Stories, "I've decided to take a step back from the situation going on considering I haven't lived with my dad in over a year and haven't spoke[n] to Collin in close to a year," adding, per Entertainment Weekly , "Having said that, I have had a relationship with my mom and other siblings for quite a few years now. And that's the only thing I'm clearing up."
 Hannah Gosselin/Instagram
 Hannah also said she would not comment further on "Collin's behavior growing up or my experiences growing up with him."
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In response to Hannah's statement, Collin pointed out that he had seen Hannah many times in the past year, adding that "all families are very complicated."
 "That statement sounded like a lot of the words of my mother, especially the last part," Collin told the hosts. "What I do believe has happened is that Hannah's caught in the middle, and nobody deserves it."
 Collin — who admitted to not having a relationship with his siblings — believes Kate, 51, is "either leveraging finances or Hannah's relationship with our siblings over Hannah."
 In the same interview, Collin confirmed that they have already filmed a large part of the Netflix documentary. 
 KRISTIN CALLAHAN – ACE PICTURES/Kristin Callahan – ACEPIXS.COM/Newscom/The Mega Agency
 "It's already filmed," he continued. "Hannah opened up about a lot of truths. Not only the things that my mom did to me and corroborated those things, but she opened up about things that she experienced at the hands of my mother."
 Advertisement Advertisement Collin believes Hannah made the statement as a form of "pre-damage control." However, he stressed that the situation isn't her fault and that she has the right to have a relationship with all the members of their family.
 "Everybody should have that right and it's not her fault," Collin added. "But I do put the blame on my mother because she's leveraging that over Hannah."
 As In Touch reported on October 12, Collin made bombshell abuse allegations against Kate in his memoir , In the Shadow of Eight: Surviving the Reality of My Childhood, which was released on October 13.
